title: Delta Cycle Recalls Ceiling Hoists with Straps Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The plastic buckles on the straps being used to hold a kayak, canoe or other large objects with the ceiling hoist can break, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,140 (In addition, about 3,390 were sold in Canada).

title: Caframo Cabinet Heaters Recalled Due to Electrocution Hazard; Manufactured by Caframo Limited
summary: The crimp holding a wire in place in the cabinet heater is not properly finished and can result in the wire detaching, posing an electrocution hazard. Units: About 2,140 (In addition, 200 units were sold in Canada).

title: Children's Jewelry Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Lead and Cadmium Poisoning; Violations of the Federal Lead Content Ban and Federal Hazardous Substances Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by Newmemo
summary: The rings contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban and levels of cadmium that are prohibited in children's products by the Federal Hazardous Substances Act. Lead and cadmium are toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,200.

title: CVB Recalls LUCID Platform Beds with Upholstered Square Tufted Headboards Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled beds can sag, break, or collapse during use, posing fall and injury hazards to consumers. Units: About 137,000 (In addition, about 890 were sold in Canada).

title: Jo-Ann Stores Recalls Place & Time Battery-Operated Desk Lamps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The desk lamp's battery compartment can overheat while using the USB charging cord, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,700.

title: Polaris Industries Recalls Ranger XD 1500 Recreational Off-Road Vehicles (ROVs) with Winches Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The winch wiring can overheat while in use, posing a fire hazard and risk of serious injury to the rider or passenger. Units: About 10,500 ROVs and 1,336 winches (In addition, about 660 ROVs were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The ATV can leak fuel at the fuel pump flange outlet, posing a fire hazard and risk of serious injury to the rider or passenger. Units: About 10,300 ATVs and 3,158 fuel pump kits and fuel tank assemblies (In addition, about 1,500 ATVs were sold in Canada).

title: Wee Gallery Recalls Baby Tummy Time Gallery Due to Violation of the Federal Phthalates Ban
summary: The recalled Baby Tummy Time Gallery art card pockets have clear plastic coverings that contain levels of a phthalate that exceeds the federal phthalates ban. Phthalates are toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 8,000 (In addition, about 50 in Canada)

title: About 866,000 AirJet and HydroJet Spa Pumps Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; One Death Reported; Manufactured by Bestway and Sold with SaluSpa, Coleman, and Hydro-Force Spa Liners
summary: The recalled AirJet and HydroJet spa pumps can overheat causing the plastic housing to ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 866,000.

title: Glen Dimplex Americas Recalls Cadet Apex72 Electric Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fan can malfunction and fail to turn on causing the unit to overheat and ignite internally, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,900.

title: GOETAS Pool Drain Covers Recalled Due to Entrapment Hazard; Violation of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com by GOETAS
summary: The recalled drain covers do not conform to the entrapment protection regulations of the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act (VGBA), posing an entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 2,500.

summary: The flashlight on the recalled kits violates the mandatory federal battery-operated toy regulation because the flashlights contain button cell batteries in a compartment that can be easily opened without requiring the use of a common household tool. title: MJKSARE High Chairs Recalled Due to Entrapment and Fall Hazards; Violation of Federal Regulation for High Chairs; Imported by Worldwide Windows; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The recalled high chairs violate the regulations for high chairs, as the leg openings on the high chair are too wide, posing an entrapment hazard to infants. Additionally, the high chairs pose a fall hazard because the tray can become disengaged from the product. Units: About 4,760.

title: Petzl America Recalls GYM, PANDION and PANJI Climbing Harnesses Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled harness can be put on backwards and the rope or carabiner can be attached to a non-weight-bearing leg loop elastic band, placing the user at risk of falling from height and sustaining serious injury, including paraplegia or death. summary: The painted long hoe and rake of the recalled garden set contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard to children. title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front bell crank in the brake linkage can fail causing the tractor to lose braking, resulting in a crash hazard. Units: About 147,900 (In addition, about 16,800 were sold in Canada).

title: Liberty Hardware Recalls Multi-Grip Tub Safety Bars Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic sticker grip pads can become dislodged after installation on tubs with tapered side walls, making the recalled Multi-Grip Tub Safety Bars unstable during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 174,500.
